name: premiere-claude-bridge
description: Assistant editor for Premiere Pro: read the project and timeline, move the playhead, add markers, queue exports.
long_description: MCP server that connects Claude to Adobe Premiere Pro through a CEP panel over a local WebSocket (127.0.0.1). This bundle contains only the MCP server. The Claude Bridge panel has to be installed in Premiere separately, see the install guide in the repository. The logging, transcription, rough cut, subtitle and QC tools of the project live in the repository as Python tools and Claude skills and are not part of this bundle.

tools.name: pr_status
tools.description: Check the connection to Premiere Pro and return basic project info

tools.name: pr_get_project_info
tools.description: Get the current project: name, path and all project items

tools.name: pr_get_active_sequence
tools.description: Get info about the active sequence

tools.name: pr_list_timeline
tools.description: List all tracks of the active sequence with every clip

tools.name: pr_get_selected
tools.description: Get the clips currently selected on the timeline

tools.name: pr_set_playhead
tools.description: Move the playhead to a given time

tools.name: pr_add_marker
tools.description: Add a marker on the active sequence

tools.name: pr_export_ame
tools.description: Queue the active sequence for export in Adobe Media Encoder

tools.name: pr_eval_jsx
tools.description: Run arbitrary ExtendScript code inside Premiere

port.title: Bridge port
port.description: Local WebSocket port the Premiere panel connects to. Change it only if you also change it in the panel.
